reasoning_content: openapi-generator-cli needs java. The devcontainer uses gradle-sdkman with JDK 21. Let me install openjdk-21-jdk-headless to provide java for the openapi generator. That's what `pnpm install`'s prepare script needs.

action.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y openjdk-21-jdk-headless 2>&1 | tail -4; java -version 2>&1; which java

tool_call.name: terminal
